name: groundcrew
description: Ground Crew skills: create a crew for a new public problem, or contribute to an existing crew through its MCP server

plugins.name: groundcrew
plugins.description: Two skills. crew-init interviews you for a mission, values, and first tasks, writes the crew directory, and validates it. crew-contribute connects to a crew's server URL, reads the contract, claims a scope, does the task, and submits findings.
